comparison.objective: Rotate a multimeter selector to its OFF detent; the candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop before function testing.
comparison.physical_skill: Direct finger contact on one shallow rotary control versus two seated tools applying coordinated opposing torque to a screw and jam nut.
comparison.success_condition: Requires final selector angle and two seconds of stillness; candidate additionally requires physical locking, nut retention, three motion cycles, and hands-off clearance.
comparison.reason: Target-angle rotation alone does not test preservation of an adjustable setpoint during mechanical locking.
